A Band Apart:
Members of the Justicar Courts take care of their own. Palanite Justicars will remain separate and aloof from the gang they are working beside. As such, Palanite Justicars cannot be included in any Group Activation actions performed by non-Palanite Justicars and vice versa.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 118)

Members of a Psi-Syndica Delegation will remain separate and aloof from the gang they are working beside. As such, Psi-Syndica Delegation Fighters cannot be included in any Group Activation actions performed by non-Psi-Syndica Delegation Fighters and vice versa.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 35)

Members of a Corpse Harvesting Party take care of their own and will remain separate and aloof from the gang they are working beside. As such, Corpse Harvesting Party Fighters cannot be included in any Group Activation actions performed by non-Corpse Harvesting Party Fighters and vice versa.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 36)

Members of a House Greim Military Attaché take care of their own and will remain separate and aloof from the gang they are working beside. As such, House Greim Military Attaché Fighters cannot be included in any Group Activation actions performed by non-House Greim Military Attaché Fighters and vice versa.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 46)

Members of a House Ko’iron Ministorum Delegation take care of their own and will remain separate and aloof from the gang they are working beside. As such, House Ko’iron Ministorum Delegation Fighters cannot be included in any Group Activation actions performed by non-House Ko’iron Ministorum Delegation Fighters and vice versa.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 48)

Members of an Enforcer Bodyguards Delegation take care of their own and will remain separate and aloof from the gang they are working beside. As such, Enforcer Bodyguards Delegation Fighters cannot be included in any Group Activation actions performed by non-Enforcer Bodyguards Fighters and vice versa.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 53)
A Charmed Life:
The incredible luck and good fortune of Kai Jericho enables him to somehow avoid all but the most deadly of attacks. This tremendous luck grants Kai a 4+ Invulnerable save roll. "Come Along, Scabs!": As Kai's loyal sidekick, Scabs (see below) may be hired alongside him for 150 credits rather than the usual 250 credits. If hired together, they count as only one Dramatis Personae.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 118)
A Jagerkin’s Duty:
If, during the Bottle Checks step of the End phase, there is no friendly Krieg Mester on the battlefield, the Jagerkin will flee the battlefield.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 46)
Acrobatic:
Finesse skill — Escher. Fighter only. While Active, may move over enemy Fighters, but must obey the 1" rule at the end of movement. May cross barricades or obstacles up to 2" high without a movement reduction.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 43; PDF p. 45.
Adaptive Biology:
Gene-smithing — Goliath. +15 credits. Recruitment only; Goliath Fighter without Beast Subtype. May re-roll Strength or Toughness checks. Successful Wound rolls against this Fighter from Toxin (X+) weapons must be re-rolled.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42.
Adaptive Mind:
Gene-smithing — Goliath. +5 credits. Recruitment only; Goliath Fighter without Beast Subtype. Counts Secondary Skill Sets as Primary when rolling on the Advancements table.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42.
Additional Attacks (X): The weapon can be used to make a number of attacks during close combat equal to X in addition to all normal attacks. This only applies during the model's activation and only if the weapon is not designated as either the model's Primary or Secondary weapon.
Adept of the Cult:
A Genestealer Cult Adept has the Wyrd Subtype and treats the Genestealer Cult Wyrd Powers as a Primary Skill Set.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 36)
Adina’s Champion:
At the start of the first round, after both gangs have deployed but before rolling for Priority, Athera challenges a Fighter belonging to the opposing gang. As long as Athera has not attacked any model other than the one she challenged, she has +1 to her Attacks characteristic and the Spring Up skill.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 4)
Administer Dose:
Action — Escher. May start the battle under this stimm if equipped, or an Active bearer may use Administer Dose (Single) on itself or a friendly Fighter within 1". Effects expire at Post-battle Wrap-up. Each purchased elixir supplies one use per Cycle and is available again next Cycle. All Escher Fighters, including variants, have access. 

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 40; PDF p. 42.
Agent of Order:
Vandoth the Fallen cannot be hired by Corpse Grinder Cult, Genestealer Cult, Genestealer Cult Corrupted, Chaos Helot, Chaos Corrupted, Malstrain, Malstrain Corrupted or Ash Waste Nomad gangs.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 32)
Agitate the Masses:
During the Choose Crews step of the Pre-battle Sequence, if a gang has an Agitator on their Gang Roster, they may declare they are using their Agitator to spread word of their impending victory. If they win the battle, they gain an additional D3 Reputation. If they lose the battle, they reduce their Reputation by 1 and the opposing gang gains an additional 1 Reputation. Additionally, an Agitator may perform the Work Territory Post-cycle Action.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 63)
Ally of House Delaque:
If recruited by a Delaque gang, a Whisper Merchant’s Credit Cost is reduced to 45 credits.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 56)
Ally of House Goliath:
If recruited by a Goliath gang, a Brute Handler’s Credit Cost is reduced to 60 credits.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 55)

If recruited by a Goliath gang, a Chem Dealer’s Credit Cost is reduced to 60 credits.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 55)
Ambush Predator:
While Active, the Malstrain Alpha may perform the Fade action during their activation: • Fade (Double): Remove the Malstrain Alpha from the battlefield. At the start of the next round, before rolling for Priority, the Malstrain Alpha is deployed on the battlefield as if using the Infiltrate skill.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 60)
Ammo (X+): After a weapon with this trait has fired, roll a D6. If the result is X or more, there is ammo left in the weapon. Otherwise, it gains the Out of Ammo Condition automatically, even if no Firepower dice are rolled. If an Out of Ammo result is also rolled on the Firepower dice in addition to rolling under X, then the weapon jams and cannot be used again for the duration of the battle, as described on page 73.
Aranthian-attuned:
A Caryatid-Servitor teleports with its master. Should they use the Archaic Displacer, set the Caryatid-Servitor up within 1" of its master at the new location.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 120)
Arc (X): A weapon with this trait has limited fields of fire, as denoted by X. A model can only target models within the field of fire with a weapon with this trait (see page 34).
Armour & Field Armour: A Fighter may not be equipped with more than one item of armour or field armour, unless the wargear explicitly says it can be combined with other armour or field armour.
Arthromite Whisperer:
A Nomad Arthromite Herder may perform the Tend Arthromite Post-cycle Action: • Tend Arthromite: Select an Arthromite Duneskuttler, Arthromite Spinewyrm, Unbound Helamite or Ashwing Helamite. If the selected Fighter is Critically Injured, it goes into Recovery. Otherwise roll a D6, on a 3+ the Fighter heals any Lasting Injuries they have and goes into Recovery.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 58)
Ashwing Lure:
While Active, an Ashwing Helamite's owner may perform the Deploy Lure action: • Deploy Lure (Single): Place an Ashwing Lure in base contact with this Fighter. For the remainder of the battle, the lure is treated as terrain and any Ashwing Helamites this Fighter controls treat the Ashwing Lure as if it were their owner. Any Fighter can perform the Interact action while within 1" of the Ashwing Lure in order to move a distance equal to their Movement characteristic and place the Ashwing Lure in base contact with the Fighter at the end of this move. Once an Ashwing Lure has been placed upon the battlefield, it may be activated as if it were a Fighter. When it is activated, all Ashwing Helamites it controls are activated as a single Group Activation.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 108)
Assault: After the bearer has performed a Dash action, they may perform a Shoot action with this weapon as a Free action.
Assault Specialist:
An Enforcer Subjugator Patrol Officer may only select one of the following specialisations: • Gunner • Brawler • Medic
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 88)
Auto-chem:
Equipment — Escher. Exclusive; 30 credits; Chem Wytch only in the House addenda. Treat Administer Dose as a Free action.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 48; PDF p. 50.
Auto-medicate:
Action — Goliath. Requires an Active Fighter equipped with servo-medicae. Free action: target itself or a friendly Active or Suppressed Fighter within 3". Make an Intelligence check for the acting Fighter; on success, the recipient regains 1 Wound lost earlier in the battle.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 48; PDF p. 50.
Automated Repair Systems:
When this Fighter tries to recover while Seriously Injured, do not roll the Injury dice - they automatically recover as if an Injured result had been rolled on the Injury dice.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 90)
Auxiliary: A weapon with this trait can only be attached to another weapon and not taken on its own. This weapon does not use one of the model's three weapon slots.

Backstab.skill: FIGHTER ONLY. All weapons with the Melee trait used by this Fighter gain the Backstab trait (see page 161). If they already have the Backstab trait, add 2 to the weapon's Strength rather than the usual 1 when the trait is used.
Backstab.weaponTrait: This weapon gains +1 Strength if the target of the attack is Engaged with more than one model.

Bad Smell:
If hired by a Cawdor gang, Rattus Tatterskin’s Credit Cost is reduced to 130 credits.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 11)
Beacon of Redemption:
Any friendly Fighter that can draw a line of sight to the Prophet may apply a +2 modifier to Cool and Willpower checks.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 26)
Beast Trainer:
An Outland Beastmaster increases the Leash range of any Pet they own by 3".
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 62)
Berserker: Fighter or Walker only. This model is subject to the Frenzy Condition (see page 48).
Bi-arm:
A Techmite Exovator may be equipped with a maximum of two weapons.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 92)
Bio-booster: The first time in each battle that the bearer gains the Injured Condition, reduce the Lethality characteristic of the weapon damaging them by 1. If the Lethality characteristic is now zero, roll 2 Injury dice instead of 1 and the bearer chooses which to apply, the other dice is discarded.
Blast (3\"/5\"): When firing a weapon with the Blast (3"/5") trait, place either the 3" or 5" Blast marker centred on the model that is being targeted. If the Hit roll succeeds, the template stays where it is. If it misses scatter it by moving it D6" in a random direction determined by the Scatter dice (if the Hit symbol is rolled, follow the direction of the small arrow above the hit), stopping if it hits impassable terrain or would go off the battlefield. If a Hit symbol and a 1 are rolled on the Scatter dice then the shot misfired: centre the blast marker on the firing model. Any model with their base at least partially under the Blast marker suffers one automatic Hit. If a weapon has both the Blast (3"/5") and the Rapid Fire (X) traits, resolve the first Blast marker as usual. Any additional Hits that would be caused due to the number of bullet holes across all the Firepower dice are resolved as Blast markers that scatter from the final location of the first Blast marker.
Blaze (X+): If the Wound roll for an attack with this trait is at least X, then the target suffers an additional Hit with the same profile as the first, even if it fails to Wound. This additional Hit must roll to Wound separately and cannot cause further additional Hits. A weapon may never benefit from more than one instance of this trait, if a weapon has this trait multiple times, only the one with the lowest value of X is used.
Blessed by the Chaos Gods:
Chaos Helot cults can perform Chaos Rituals (see page 44).
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 46)

When a Chaos Spawn is taken Out of Action, do not roll on the Lasting Injury table. They are always considered to be Out Cold.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 50)
Blessed by the Lost Saint:
The Prophet of the Redemption seems to lead a blessed life; none can act against him, either looking upon him with awe or finding they purposefully miss. If an enemy model wishes to make a Fight, Shoot, Aimed Shot or Braced Shot action that targets the Prophet of the Redemption, they must make a Willpower check. If the check is failed, they cannot perform the action and their activation ends immediately. In addition, the Prophet of the Redemption has a 3+ Invulnerable Save.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 26)
Blood Rush:
Stimm — Escher. 15 credits. When administered, the recipient immediately regains 1 Wound lost earlier in the battle.

May start the battle under this stimm if equipped, or an Active bearer may use Administer Dose (Single) on itself or a friendly Fighter within 1". Effects expire at Post-battle Wrap-up. Each purchased elixir supplies one use per Cycle and is available again next Cycle. All Escher Fighters, including variants, have access. 

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 40; PDF p. 42.
Bodyguard:
If the Magistrate is hit by a ranged attack, the controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto an Active or Suppressed Bailiff within 2" of the Magistrate. [Text as changed by the N26 FAQ and Errata, September 2026, p. 118 Bailiff.]
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 120)

If Klovis the Redeemer is hit by a ranged attack, his controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto Deacon Malakev if he is either Active or Suppressed and within 2" of Klovis the Redeemer.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 10)

If the Pale Consort is hit by a ranged attack, the controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto an Active or Suppressed Corpse Grinder within 2" of the Pale Consort.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 37)

If the Chain Lord is hit by a ranged attack, the controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto an Active or Suppressed Pit Fighter within 2" of the Chain Lord.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 41)

If the Master Nautican is hit by a ranged attack, the controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto an Active or Suppressed Subnautican within 2" of the Master Nautican.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 43)

If the Krieg Mester is hit by a ranged attack, the controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto an Active or Suppressed Jagerkin within 2" of the Krieg Mester.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 46)

If the Prima Materis is hit by a ranged attack, the controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto an Active or Suppressed Frateris Bodyguard within 2" of the Prima Materis.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 49)

If the Fighter the Palanite Companions are assigned to protect is hit by a ranged attack, the controlling player may choose to transfer the Hit and all of its effects onto an Active or Suppressed Palanite Companion within 2" of the Fighter.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 53)
Bonded to the Rig:
A Spyre Hunt Master may never have their Sovereign hunting rig unequipped from them, and if they are removed from the Gang Roster this item is also removed instead of being placed into the gang's Stash.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 74)

A Jakara Spyre Hunter may never have their Jakara hunting rig or mirror shield unequipped from them, and if they are removed from the Gang Roster these items are also removed instead of being placed into the gang's Stash.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 74)

A Malcadon Spyre Hunter may never have their Malcadon hunting rig, drop rig, grapnel launcher or paired web incisors unequipped from them, and if they are removed from the Gang Roster these items are also removed instead of being placed into the gang's Stash.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 76)

An Orrus Spyre Hunter may never have their Orrus hunting rig unequipped from them, and if they are removed from the Gang Roster this item is also removed instead of being placed into the gang's Stash.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 76)
Breaching (X+): If an attack from a weapon with this trait successfully Wounds its target and the Wound roll is at least X, Armour saves cannot be made against the attack.
Bulging Biceps: Fighter only. When performing a Braced Shot action, the Fighter may move a distance equal to their Initiative characteristic in inches either before or after resolving the ranged attack. When attacking with a weapon with the Heavy trait in close combat, the Fighter may declare a Secondary weapon as long as the Secondary weapon does not also have the Heavy trait.
Bull Charge: Fighter or Vehicle. When the model makes close combat attacks as part of a Charge action, any close combat weapons they use gain the Knockback (6+) trait and are resolved at +1 Strength.
Burrowing:
A Psychoteric Wyrm is able to burrow beneath and through the metal and rockcrete floors of the underhive, passing quickly through hidden crawl spaces and buried vents, before emerging elsewhere. A Psychoteric Wyrm may move freely under impassable terrain if it has sufficient movement to do so, but may not end its movement on or within impassable terrain.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 30)
Call the Storm:
While equipped with a Stormcaller staff, an Active Ash Waste Nomad Stormcaller can perform the Dust Storm action: • Dust Storm (Single): If the Visibility (X") rule is not active for this battle, apply the Visibility (24") rule. Otherwise, either increase or decrease the value of X" by 6" to a minimum of 6". These effects last for the remainder of the battle and can be modified further by future uses of this ability.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 104)
Carapace Armour – Heavy: Heavy carapace armour improves a Fighter's Save characteristic by 2. In addition, they reduce their Initiative characteristic by 2 and apply a -1 modifier to all Agility tests they make.
Carapace Armour – Light: Light carapace armour improves a Fighter's Save characteristic by 1. In addition, they reduce their Initiative characteristic by 1.
Catfall: Fighter or Walker only. When this model falls or jumps down from a ledge, they count the vertical distance as being one level less than normal (see page 69). In addition, if they are not Seriously Injured/Damaged or taken Out of Action by a fall, make an Agility test for them – if it is passed, they do not become Suppressed.
Charmed Companion:
A Caryatid Prime is able to help their chosen companion avoid damage. While they are within Leash range of their owner, that Fighter may re-roll one failed save each round.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 76)
Chem Slug:
Action — Goliath. Requires an Active chem slugger bearer. Single action: target a friendly Fighter within 2"; it may perform one additional action during its next activation. At the end of that activation, roll D6: 1–3 causes a Str -, AP -, L1 Hit that automatically Wounds with no saves; 4+ has no further effect.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 48; PDF p. 50.
Chem Slugger:
Equipment — Goliath. Exclusive; 45 credits. An Active bearer may perform Chem Slug (Single): target a friendly Fighter within 2". During its next activation the target may perform an additional action. At the end of that activation roll D6: on 4+, no further effect; on 1–3, it suffers a Str -, AP -, L1 Hit that automatically Wounds, with no saves allowed. Forge Patcher only in House Goliath/Furnace Brutes; Forge Patcher or Unborn Doc in Unborn.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 48; PDF p. 50.
Chem-alchemy:
Chem-alchemy — Escher. Each purchased elixir supplies one use per Cycle and is available again next Cycle. All Escher Fighters, including variants, have access. Stimms can be administered during battle; gaseous ammo and poisons are applied after crews are selected.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42-43.
Chem-alchemy Adept:
Special rule — Escher. On recruitment, an Escher Chem Mother adds one Chem-alchemy Elixir to her equipment for free.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 37; PDF p. 39.
Clamber: Fighter only. When this Fighter climbs, the distance they move is not halved. In other words, they always count as climbing up or down a ladder.
Combat Chems Stash:
Whenever a Goliath Stimmer is activated, they may choose to use Combat Chems. Until the End phase of this round they gain an additional +D3 Attacks. However, if the dice roll is a natural 1, they instead suffer a bad reaction and their Attacks characteristic is reduced to 1 until the End phase of this round.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 52)

Whenever Gorshiv Hammerfist is activated, he may choose to use Combat Chems. Until the End phase of this round, he gains an additional +D3 Attacks. However, if the dice roll is a natural 1, he instead suffers a bad reaction and his Attacks characteristic is reduced to 1 until the End phase of this round.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 6)
Combat Master: Fighter or Walker only. The model never suffers penalties to their Hit rolls for interference, and can always grant assists, regardless of how many enemy models they are Engaged with.
Combi: When a weapon with this trait is fired as part of a Shoot or Aimed Shot action, the model's controller can choose which profile to resolve the attack with before rolling the dice. If they wish, they can attack with both profiles targeting the same model, applying a -1 modifier to the Hit roll for each profile. These attacks are resolved simultaneously.
Concussive (X+): If an attack from a weapon with this trait successfully Wounds its target and the Wound roll is at least X, the target reduces their Initiative characteristic by 1 until the end of their next activation.
Connected: Fighter or Vehicle. This model can perform a Visit Trading Post Action during the Post-cycle Sequence that adds 1 TP instead of the normal amount, in addition to any other actions they make (meaning they could even make two Visit Trading Post Actions). They cannot do this if they are unable to perform actions during the Post-cycle Sequence.
Control Collar:
When this Fighter is activated, decide if its control collar is active for the round. If it is active then the control collar of the Onmyodo Null will be inactive for the round (note that it is possible for both collars to be inactive at the same time, but that if one is active, the other is automatically inactive). This Fighter only has the Wyrd Subtype while its collar is inactive.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 51)
Counter-Attack: Fighter or Walker only. When an enemy model resolves a Fight action involving this model, this model may make an additional attack with their weapon. This additional attack is resolved at the same Initiative as the enemy model's attacks.
Counter-charge:
If the Sumpkroc's owner is Engaged by an enemy Fighter as the result of the enemy Fighter making a Charge or Engage action, and if the Sumpkroc is Active, it may immediately activate and make a Charge action, moving towards the Engaging enemy Fighter. This activation interrupts the enemy Fighter's action, being performed after movement but before attacks. A Sumpkroc may only make one Counter-charge per round.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 54)
Creation of the Star Chamber:
If hired by a Delaque gang, the Servant of the Silent Ones’ Credit Cost is reduced to 220 credits.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 12)
Creature of Shadows:
Yageloth is not wholly human anymore and perhaps not even corporeal. Attacks without a Strength characteristic (such as those with the Toxin (X+) trait) have no effect on Yageloth. In addition, if Yageloth becomes Seriously Injured, remove him from the battlefield. At the start of the End phase of that round, place Yageloth anywhere on the battlefield within 5" of a friendly Fighter and at least 1" from any enemy Fighters and set his Status to Active.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 12)
Crucible Hooks:
Weapon — Goliath. Profile: SR E; LR -; Str S+1; AP -2; L 2; Melee, Paired (2). 60 credits; Forge Breaker only in House addenda/Furnace Brutes.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 47; PDF p. 48.
Crush (Free):
Closing their fist in the air, the wyrd crushes an object in their eyeline. Target a single obstacle that is both within 12" and Line of Sight of this Fighter; the obstacle is destroyed and removed from the battlefield.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 94)
Cult of Personality:
All Outcast Fighters within 6" of the gang's Leader automatically pass any Nerve checks they need to make and are unaffected by models with the Fearsome Condition.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 10)
Cult Uprising:
Genestealer Cult Fighters apply a +1 modifier to the dice roll when attempting to perform the Coup de Grace action.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 34)
Cursed: A model hit by a weapon with the Cursed trait must pass a Willpower check or become subject to the Insanity Condition. If the Hit roll for a weapon with the Cursed trait is a natural 1, the bearer must pass a Willpower check or become subject to the Insanity Condition.
Custom Outrider:
When Vespa ‘Minx’ Merdena performs the Dash action, she adds 6" to her Movement characteristic instead of her Initiative.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 8)
Cut-Throat: Fighter only. When performing a Coup de Grâce action, after both players have rolled their D6, this Fighter may re-roll their dice.
Damage (X): If a model is wounded by an attack with a weapon with this trait, they lose X Wounds rather than the usual one. Note that if this results in Injury dice being rolled, the number rolled is equal to the Lethality characteristic of the weapon, regardless of the number of Wounds lost.
Data-slug Overlay:
Gene-smithing — Goliath. -10 credits. Recruitment only; Goliath Fighter without Beast Subtype. On its first activation of the battle, make an Intelligence check. On failure, this Fighter gains Insanity.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42.
Dauntless:
Ironhead Squats do not need to make Nerve checks when a friendly Fighter goes Out of Action within 3".
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 90)
Deadly Blows:
Finesse skill — Escher. Fighter only. When resolving close combat attacks, if this Fighter’s modified Initiative exceeds that of every other model in the combat, one Injury die may be re-rolled when resolving damage inflicted by this Fighter.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 43; PDF p. 45.
Deadly Poisons:
Special rule — Escher. All weapons with Toxin (X+) and without Shred (X+) wielded by Chymist Cult Fighters gain Shred (6+).

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 34; PDF p. 36.
Dealer In Death:
If an enemy Fighter is taken Out of Action while at least one Active or Suppressed friendly Cadaver Merchant is on the battlefield, add D3x5 credits to the gang’s Stash.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 61)
Death Rites:
Post-cycle action — Escher. Chymist Cult Fighter only. Resolve at the start of Update Roster. Select another Fighter in the gang who is not already a Death-Maiden and has Champion, Ganger, Leader or Prospect. The target may have suffered Critical Injury or Memorable Death this cycle, but may not perform Post-cycle Actions or be targeted by Medical Escort. Pay 60 credits and make an Intelligence check for the acting Fighter.

Failure: delete the target from the roster and place its equipment in the Stash. Success: remove all Lasting Injuries, increase Toughness by 1, make it a Death-Maiden for all purposes, change Type to Fighter (Champion, Loner), and grant Poison Blood (Gangs of the Underhive p. 37). It may keep now-ineligible equipment but cannot be given additional such equipment.

Dire Premonitions:
Those near a Caryatid-Servitor's twisted form are granted visions of their grisly and inevitable demise. Enemy Fighters who end their activation within 3" of one must make a Nerve check.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 120)
Dirt Bike: A Fighter equipped with a dirt bike gains the Mounted Subtype and sets their Movement characteristic to 8". When they perform a Dash action, they add 5" to their Movement characteristic instead of their Initiative.
Dodge: Fighter or Vehicle. If this model suffers a Wound from a shooting or close combat attack (including as a result of the Unstable trait), roll a D6. On a 6, the attack is dodged and has no further effect; otherwise, continue to make a save or resolve the Wound as normal. Drag: If a model is hit by a weapon with the Drag trait but not taken Out of Action, the attacker can attempt to drag the target closer after the attack has been resolved. If they do, roll a D6. If they move into another model (other than the attacker), both models are moved the remaining distance directly towards the attacker. This movement can cause models to fall (see page 69). Once this movement has been resolved, any models that are now within 1" of an enemy model are moved the shortest distance possible to be Engaged with that model.
Drop Rig: An Active or Suppressed Fighter with a drop rig can perform the Descend action while they are within 1" of the edge of a platform. Descend (Single): The Fighter makes a move of up to 3" horizontally and up to 12" vertically. Any vertical movement must be downwards, i.e., towards the ground.
Drudging Classes:
An Orlock gang may have one extra Fighter perform the Work Territory Post-cycle action.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 64)
Early Generation Hybrid:
A Genestealer Cult Alpha benefits from the Extra Arm rule.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 36)

Post-cycle action — Goliath. Furnace Brutes Fighter only. Select a Primitive Weapon or Repurposed Tool with Melee that the Fighter carries or that is in the Stash. Pay 10 credits and select one permanent change:
• If it lacks Unwieldy: +1 Lethality and add Unwieldy.
• If it lacks both Heavy and Paired: +1 Strength and add Heavy.
• Add Concussive (6+) if absent; otherwise reduce X by 1, minimum 4.
• Improve AP by 1, to a minimum of -2.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 48; PDF p. 50.

Delving deep into the subconscious of their foe, the wyrd dredges up every dream and horror they can find, making the victim doubt their very reality. Gene-smithing — Goliath. +15 credits. Recruitment only; Goliath Fighter without Beast Subtype. Roll twice for this Fighter’s Lasting Injury and apply the lower result. Cannot be combined with Over-engineered.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42.
Reflect Shroud: The wearer counts the AP of any Las, Plasma or Melta Weapon as '-' regardless of their actual AP.
Reflex Enhancers:
During the Ready Gang step of the Priority Phase, all Spyrers gain one extra Ready marker; if an effect would prevent them from gaining a Ready marker, they gain one fewer Ready marker. Each time a Spyrer activates, they only remove one Ready marker - this means they will be able to activate twice each round. Any effect that removes Ready markers or prevents them from being added only affects one Ready marker.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 72)

During the Ready Gang step of the Priority Phase, Ozostium Aranthus gains one extra Ready marker; if an effect would prevent him from gaining a Ready marker, he gains one fewer Ready marker. Each time Ozostium Aranthus activates, he only removes one Ready marker - this means he will be able to activate twice each round. Any effect that removes Ready markers or prevents them from being added only affects one Ready marker.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 120)
Refractor Field: A refractor field grants its wearer a 5+ Invulnerable Save; however, should a natural 1 be rolled when making the Invulnerable Save then the refractor field is burnt out and cannot be used again for the rest of the battle. A refractor field may be combined with other armour and field armour.
Regeneration:
An Active Khimerix may perform the Regenerate action: • Regenerate (Single): The Khimerix may move a distance equal to its Movement characteristic and then roll a D6. If the result is a natural 4+, the Khimerix immediately recovers 1 Wound previously lost in this battle.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 42)
Reliable: A weapon with this trait ignores the first Out of Ammo symbol rolled each round on the Firepower dice.

Weapon — Escher. Profile: SR 9"; LR 18"; Str -; AP -1; L 1; Rapid Fire (1), Toxin (3+). 55 credits; Gun Maiden only in House addenda.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 47; PDF p. 49.
Respirator: When a Fighter equipped with a respirator is hit by a weapon with the Gas trait, they gain a 5+ Invulnerable save against that weapon.
Restrain (Double):
Target an enemy Fighter that this Fighter is Engaged with; the enemy Fighter must make an Agility test. If the test is failed, they have been locked in place and become subject to the Webbed Condition.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 92)
Rites of the Moraegan:
Special rule — Escher. Chymist Cult Fighters may perform the Death Rites Post-cycle Action.

While an Orlock Arms Master is on the battlefield, their gang may re-roll Bottle checks.

Sanctioned Wyrd:
An Enforcer Haunt is specialised in an area of wyrd manifestation; when added to a Gang Roster each Enforcer Haunt selects one of the following types: • Psyrender: A Psyrender knows one Psyrender Wyrd Power of the player's choice and may gain additional Psyrender Wyrd Powers as if they were Primary skills. (see page 92). • Bonecrusher: A Bonecrusher knows one Bonecrusher Wyrd Power of the player's choice and may gain additional Bonecrusher Wyrd Powers as if they were Primary skills (see page 92).
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 88)
Scar Tissue:
Gene-smithing — Goliath. +15 credits. Recruitment only; Goliath Fighter without Beast Subtype. Reduce the Lethality of all hits suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42.
Scarce (X+): If a weapon has the Scarce (X+) trait then when the Reload action is performed, instead of the weapon automatically having more ammo the player must roll a D6. If the result is at least X then the weapon is successfully reloaded, otherwise the weapon is still Out of Ammo, though further attempts can be made in later activations.
Scourge of the Spider Points:
If hired by a Goliath gang, Axon Hammer’s Credit Cost is reduced to 250 credits.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 6)
Scout Ahead:
After deployment but before the first roll for Priority, if a Dome Runner is on the battlefield, D3 friendly Fighters may move a distance equal to their Initiative characteristic. Fighters may only move due to this special rule once per battle.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 126)
Seize the Prize:
During the Post-cycle Sequence this Fighter may perform the Claim Jump Post-cycle Action. • Claim Jump: Select a rival gang that your gang fought against this cycle and roll a D6. On a result of a 5+ immediately gain the Boons of a random Territory that the chosen gang controls (this does not prevent the Territory’s owner gaining the Boons).
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 59)
Sensor Array:
If a Cephalopod Spektor is within Leash range of its owner when the owner is required to make an Intelligence check for any reason, roll an extra D6, picking one of the dice to discard.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 30)
Sensor Suite:
An Ironhead Squat Vartijan Exo-Driller treats the Visibility (X") rule as being 3" higher than it is.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 92)
Servant of the Delaque:
A Spyker may only be recruited by a Delaque gang.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 56)

A Psychoteric Thrall may only be recruited by a Delaque gang.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 57)
Servant of the Escher:
A Shivver may only be recruited by an Escher gang.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 54)
Servo-arm:
Weapon — Goliath. Profile: SR E; LR -; Str S+3; AP -; L 2; Concussive (5+), Melee, Unwieldy. 65 credits in supplied lists.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 47; PDF p. 48.
Servo-harness – Full: A Fighter wearing a full servo-harness gains all of the benefits of a partial servo-harness, but without the negative modifiers to their Movement and Initiative characteristics. This item cannot be combined with a servo-claw or any other type of servo-harness.
Servo-harness – Partial: A Fighter wearing a partial servo-harness gains a +2 modifier to their Strength characteristic and a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic. However, a Fighter wearing a partial servo-harness reduces their Movement and Initiative characteristics by 1. This item cannot be combined with a servo-claw or any other type of servo-harness.
Servo-medicae:
Equipment — Escher / Goliath. Exclusive; 30 credits. An Active bearer may perform Auto-medicate (Free): target itself or a friendly Active or Suppressed Fighter within 3". Make an Intelligence check for the bearer; on success the target regains 1 Wound lost earlier in the battle. The same rule appears in both released journals. Access: Chem Wytch in House Escher addenda; Forge Patcher in House Goliath/Furnace Brutes lists; Forge Patcher or Unborn Doc in Unborn.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 48; PDF p. 50; Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 48; PDF p. 50.
Shadow of the Malstrain:
A Malstrain Coalescence treats Malstrain Wyrd Powers as a Primary Skill Set.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 60)
Sharpened Claws:
Weapon — Escher. Profile: SR E; LR -; Str -; AP -1; L 1; Melee, Toxin (3+). Alpha Phelynx is armed with these.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 47; PDF p. 49.
Sharpshooter: Fighter or Vehicle. When performing the Aimed Shot action, this model applies a +2 modifier to their Hit roll instead of +1.
Shield: If a model is equipped with at least one weapon with this trait, they increase their Save characteristic by 1 against shooting attacks (note: a model gains no further benefit from being equipped with multiple weapons with this trait).
Shock (X+): If an attack from a weapon with this trait hits and the Hit roll is at least X then it automatically Wounds and is considered to have rolled a natural 6 on the Wound roll for the purposes of any other traits.
Shockwave:
Action — Goliath. Requires Ground Pound and an Active Fighter. Double action: roll D6 + Strength. On 6+, all OTHER Active Fighters within 6", friend and foe, become Suppressed.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 43; PDF p. 44.

Single Shot: A weapon with this trait can only be fired once per battle, at which point it automatically goes Out of Ammo and cannot be reloaded by any means.
Slow-witted:
Ogryns are not especially bright or quick on the uptake. This Fighter may never be activated as part of a Group Activation action.

Small Target:
Arthromite Spinewyrms are low to the ground and surprisingly fast, making them difficult to target in the vast expanse of the ash wastes. Ranged attacks against Arthromite Spinewyrms are made at -1 to Hit.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 106)
Smiths of Renown:
Special rule — Goliath. Furnace Brutes Fighters may perform the Enhance Weapon Post-cycle Action.

Smoke: A weapon with this trait does not have to target an enemy model; it may instead target a point on the battlefield. After the final position of the Blast marker has been determined, leave the Blast marker in place on the battlefield – a column of smoke of infinite height rises up from the Blast marker which blocks Line of Sight. If the column hits a terrain feature, it stops at the edge of the terrain feature. During the Reinforcement step of the End phase, roll a D6 for each Blast marker placed by this trait; on a result of a 5+, the Blast marker remains in place, otherwise it is removed. A model hit by a Smoke grenade is never wounded by the attack and they are not Suppressed.
Solitary Hunter:
A Ripperjack never gains the benefit of an assist or grants an assist to other Fighters.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 128)

Finesse skill — Escher. Fighter only. While Active, may perform Somersault (Double): place this Fighter anywhere within 6" of its current position. The destination must be visible before moving, and placement must obey the 1" rule.

At the start of the battle, before the first roll for Priority, Ortruum 8-8’s controlling player nominates an enemy Fighter deployed on the battlefield. This Fighter is the target Ortruum 8-8 has been sent to track down and while Ortruum 8-8 is on the battlefield, the selected Fighter is haloed by ghostly illumination, reducing the benefit the selected Fighter gains from cover by 1.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 30)
Spare Mount:
If an Unbound Helamite's owner is equipped with a Dustback Helamite and is Suppressed whilst within 1" of an Active Unbound Helamite, they may make an Agility test. If the test is passed, the Unbound Helamite changes its Status to Suppressed instead of its owner.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 108)
Spring Up: Fighter only. If this Fighter is Suppressed when they are activated, make an Agility test for them. If the test is passed, the Fighter is no longer Suppressed and may perform two actions as normal.
Sprint: Fighter or Walker only. While Active this model may perform the Sprint action. Sprint (Double): The model may move a distance equal to their Movement characteristic plus twice their Initiative characteristic in inches. Any rule that replaces a model's Initiative with a different number for the purpose of the Dash action also replaces it for Sprint.
Spyrer Companion:
A Caryatid Prime is subject to the Reflex Enhancers special rule (see page 68).
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 76)
Stand Firm:
Action — Goliath. Requires Immovable Object. Double action during activation: +2 to Armour Saves until the start of the next activation; cannot be moved by any means or Suppressed.

Steady Supply:

(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 55)
Stimm Implant:
Gene-smithing — Goliath. +10 credits. Recruitment only; Goliath Fighter without Beast Subtype. When activating, may increase Strength by 2 until the end of the round. If used, roll D6 during the Bottle Checks step of the End phase: on 4+, suffer a Str -, AP -, L1 Hit that automatically Wounds and ignores Saves.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42.
Stimm-slug Stash: Once per battle, a Fighter equipped with a stimm-slug stash may use it at the start of their activation. Until their next activation increase their Movement, Strength and Toughness characteristics by 2. At the start of their next activation, these effects wear off and the Fighter's controller must roll a D6; on a 2+ nothing happens but on a result of a 1 they suffer a bad reaction to the stimms – they suffer a Str -, AP -, L1 Hit that automatically Wounds with no saves allowed.
Summary Judgement:
If the Executioner takes an enemy Fighter Out of Action with a Coup de Grace action, any Bailiffs within 3" of the Executioner may immediately perform a Shoot action as a Free action without removing their Ready marker, even if they are not Ready.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 118)
Sure-footed:
Special rule — Escher. All Wyld Hunt Fighters may re-roll failed Agility tests.

Source: Necromunda_Skirmish_journal_Esher_2026.pdf, printed p. 30; PDF p. 32.
Survivor:
Gene-smithing — Goliath. +10 credits. Recruitment only; Goliath Fighter without Beast Subtype. May re-roll one Injury die when making Recovery tests for this Fighter.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 40-41; PDF p. 42.
Suspensors: Weapons marked with * only. A weapon fitted with suspensors only counts as one weapon when calculating how many weapons a Fighter may carry, instead of the normal two.

A Claim Jumper may only be recruited by Ironhead Squat Prospectors.

Target Paint:
While at least one Techmite Oculi is within 6" of an enemy Fighter, its owner counts at short range for the purposes of calculating cover bonuses.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 94)

While Old Faithful is within 6" of an enemy Fighter, its owner counts as firing at short range for the purposes of calculating cover bonuses.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 24)
Telescopic Sight: A weapon fitted with a telescopic sight reduces the benefit a model gains to their Armour save for being in cover by 1 while within the weapon's Long Range.
Template: When a weapon with the Template trait is fired, place the teardrop-shaped template so that the narrow end is in base contact with the firing model and the targeted model is under the template. Any model either partially under the template or with any part of their base under the template is automatically hit, there is no need to roll to Hit. If a weapon has both the Template and the Light trait then if it is used in close combat one opposing enemy model suffers one automatic Hit; do not place the template. If a weapon has both the Template and the Rapid Fire (X) traits then the model that is closest to the firing model is hit a number of times, as determined by the Firepower dice; all other models are hit just once.
Tenacious:
Hardcase Cyber-Mastiffs are renowned for their tenacity. If a Hardcase Cyber-Mastiff is taken Out of Action, do not remove it from the battlefield if it has not yet activated this round. During this activation it may act as if it was Active and once the Hardcase Cyber-Mastiff has completed its activation, remove it from the battlefield.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 88)

Hardcase Cyber-Mastiffs are renowned for their tenacity. If KB-88 is taken Out of Action, do not remove them from the battlefield if they have not yet activated this round. (Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 18)
Tend Patient:
An Escher Chem Wytch may perform the Medical Escort Post-cycle Action. This action costs 20 credits less than normal.
(Source: Escher Journal 2026 (House of Blades), PDF p. 41)
Terrify (Double):
Planting a horrific image in the enemy's mind, the wyrd tries to break their spirit. Choose a single enemy Fighter that is both within 18" and Line of Sight of this Fighter. (Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 94)

An Underhive Trader may perform the Visit Trading Post Post-cycle Action as if they were a Leader.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 64)

Asun’ghar may only be hired by an Ash Waste Nomads gang.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 21)
The Liber Excruciatus:

D3 enemy Fighters (chosen by Klovis the Redeemer’s controlling player) that are within 9" of Klovis the Redeemer and that can draw a line of sight to him must immediately make a Nerve check with a -1 modifier.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 10)
The Thane’s Executioner:
If hired by a Cawdor gang, the Headsman’s Credit Cost is reduced to 135 credits.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 11)

When selecting starting Crews or Reinforcements, divide the number of models allowed by two, rounding up, to determine the number of Spyrers that may be selected. For example, if 3 Reinforcements would arrive, only two Spyrers arrive.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 72)
Tinker:
If a Heretek is included as part of a gang’s starting crew, they may enhance a weapon belonging to a friendly Fighter. (Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 60)
Tireless Worker:

Transport Area:
A Guild of Coin Ridgehauler and each of its trailers has a transport area along the side of each cargo load. If no cargo load is purchased, the area where it would be loaded is a transport bed as well.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 130)

Two-Weapon Fighter: Fighter or Walker only. In close combat, this model makes two attacks with their Secondary weapon as opposed to the normal one.

Muscle skill — Goliath. Fighter only. May perform Flex while Engaged. Flex (Double): all other Fighters within 1", friend or foe, must pass a Strength check or be pushed D3" directly away. Stop only on contact with another Fighter or impassable terrain. Test for falling if pushed off a ledge. This Fighter’s controller chooses the order if several Fighters are pushed.

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 43; PDF p. 44.
Unnatural Corpus:
A Caryatid-Servitor is made by reanimating a Caryatid's corpse with archeo-tech, All other Pets are provoked by its unnatural scent. If they begin their activation within charge range of a Caryatid-Servitor (even if they are Panicked), they must pass a Willpower check to be able to activate normally; if they fail they must perform a Charge action with the Caryatid-Servitor as their target. If they are Engaged with a Caryatid-Servitor, they may only perform the Fight action.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Outlands, PDF p. 120)
Unstable: If the Hit roll for a weapon with the Unstable trait is a natural 1, then the model using the weapon suffers an automatic Hit using this weapon's profile and no other models are hit by the weapon. If the weapon does not need to roll to Hit (for example, it has the Template trait) then roll a D6 before resolving the attack as described previously.
Unstoppable: Fighter or Vehicle. Each time this model activates, before performing any actions with them, make a Willpower check. If the check is passed, they recover 1 Wound lost earlier in the battle.
Unstoppable Force:
Muscle skill — Goliath. Fighter only. In an activation in which this Fighter performs a Charge action, all its Melee weapons also gain Knockback (4+), and it may consolidate an additional 2".

Source: Necromunda Skirmish 2026 House of Chains - Goliath Journal.pdf, printed p. 43; PDF p. 44.
Unwieldy: When a model attacks with a weapon with this trait in close combat, their Initiative is set to 1 before applying any modifiers.

Vox Disruption:
Enemy Fighters within 9" of Silberlant Sevos may not perform the Group Activation action.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 28)
Warped Monstrosity:
When a Chaos Spawn is added to the Gang Roster, roll a D6 for each characteristic in their profile and consult the table below to determine their value: D6 1 — WS 5+, S 3, T 4, W 1, I 2, A 1, Sv 6+. D6 2-5 — WS 4+, S 4, T 5, W 2, I 3, A 2, Sv 5+. D6 6 — WS 3+, S 5, T 6, W 3, I 4, A 3, Sv 4+.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 108)
Wastes’ Most Wanted:
Axon Hammer has one of the highest bounties on his head of any raider in the wastes. If Axon Hammer suffers either a Memorable Death result (66 on the Lasting Injury table) or a Captured result (61-62 on the Lasting Injury table) when taken Out of Action, the opposing gang adds 100 credits to their Stash during the battle’s End phase as they collect the bounty.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 6)
Weapon Accessories: Each weapon may only have one weapon accessory attached.
Web: Armour Saves cannot be taken against a weapon with this Trait, though Invulnerable Saves may still be taken. If a Fighter is wounded by a weapon with the Web trait, then instead of losing a Wound, they gain the Webbed Condition as described on page 48.
Well Drilled:
Palanite Enforcers are trained to operate together and co-ordinate their fire. All Active Palanite Enforcers may perform the Group Activation action as a Free action.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 86)
Well Fed:
If a Slopper is on the battlefield, once per battle you can force your opponent to re-roll the dice when rolling on the Lasting Injuries table.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 126)

If Bigby Crumb is on the battlefield, once per battle you can force your opponent to re-roll the dice when rolling on the Lasting Injuries table.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 28)
Whispered Secrets:
If a gang has a ’Narker, they may re-roll the dice when determining how far away from enemy models Reinforcements must be placed.
(Source: Necromunda Additional Rules - Most Wanted, PDF p. 61)
Whispers in the Dark:
When added to a Gang Roster, this Fighter selects a Psychoteric Whispers Wyrd Power.
(Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 30)
Words of Wrath (Single):
This Fighter reads aloud from the Book of the Redemption. (Source: Necromunda Skirmish - Gangs of the Underhive, PDF p. 20)
